name: VCGBench-Diverse
description: VCGBench-Diverse is a video understanding benchmark covering 18 broad video categories with 4,354 question-answer pairs. It evaluates generalization of video large multimodal models on dense video captioning, spatial and temporal understanding, and complex reasoning.
reputation: A niche but useful benchmark for stress-testing generalization in video-language models, with limited but growing adoption in the VLM community.
notes: Covers diverse video categories and tasks including dense captioning and reasoning; complements existing video benchmarks.
